title: Mixed Trio #21
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, extraordinarily large women, far beyond any real person, a mix of pregnant and non-pregnant figures.

Her pregnant belly is exceptionally wide as well as high, stretched into a broad, taut, smoothly rounded dome far wider than an ordinary single pregnancy, the navel pushed flat and outward at its highest point, faint linea nigra running down its centre. A full heavy bust above it, wide round hips below, soft thick thighs and arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, flawless pale-golden skin, sharply defined dark brows, a precise black winged liner with a strong flick, warm brown-bronze eyeshadow, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour under the cheekbones, deep red glossy lips with a crisp edge, long glossy black waves, a poised, dramatic expression, curly hair, real pores, real living eyes, 25 studs piercings set with amethysts in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of gold earrings. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, extreme gold extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her face is a real living adult face, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, high ponytail hair, real pores, real living eyes, 100 segment rings piercings set with diamonds in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of mixed-metal a bracelet. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip, the elbow held away, extreme white extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#3: Nigerian, in her late 30s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — a stunning hourglass figure carrying a full-term pregnancy, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projecting forward well past her own chest, the navel pushed slightly outward, and below the belly her hips flare wide and curvaceous. Her face is a real living adult face, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, long braids piled into a high sculpted crown, a bright, joyful smile, sleek straight hair, real pores, real living eyes, 25 segment rings piercings set with rubies in brass-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of mixed-metal a hair ornament. Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
